subject: english
question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error’. 

Why are you making excuses too avoid this work?
solution:
The correct answer is "**making excuses too.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the error lies in the usage of the word "too." 
 
• **The correct word should be "to" instead of "too".**
 
• **We use to before a verb to make the to-infinitive form**.
 
 
• Example: She loves to wear really beautiful dresses.
 
 
 
• While, "too" is used to mean "also" or to indicate excessiveness.
 
 
• Example: The movie was too good.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, "to" will be used before the verb "active" to make the infinitive form.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.
